answer.summary: E2E job failed because the app never came up: /api/me returned no HTTP response for 300s. The log shows the last migration ran, then SpringApplication logged an ERROR about 20s later, so the app crashed on startup rather than timing out. The truncated excerpt doesn't show the exception, so the cause is unknown. The PR adds payload-identity and migration changes, so a deterministic startup failure is more likely than a flake. Check the full ERROR stack trace before retrying.
